items.title: Luxury cruise passengers stranded in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs
items.description: The Villa Vie Odyssey suspended its voyage and is working with passengers on "temporary living arrangements".

items.title: Serbian shot dead after attacking officer outside Israeli embassy, minister says
items.description: Authorities say the attacker in Belgrade was an underage male who was being monitored by security services.

items.title: Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years
items.description: The energy minister described it as a "major milestone" for the East African nation.

items.title: Anger in Kenya over extradition hearing delay for ex-British soldier accused of murdering woman
items.description: No official reason has been given for postponing next month’s hearing to May 2027, the family says.

items.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
items.description: The truce was originally planned for the stranded residents of Oleshky, and Russia and Ukraine say no breaches have been reported.

items.title: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
items.description: The King is on a nine-day tour that will take him to three countries, including the Bahamas, Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda.

items.title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard
items.description: The woman began her career at the park when she was 17 and had worked there on-and-off for four decades.

items.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
items.description: An end to the conflict in Ukraine "will not be achieved through silence," Finland's President Alexander Stubb said.

items.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
items.description: The Trump-Lula relationship may have thawed, but several issues could reignite tensions between the two leaders.

items.title: Ex-wife of Zimbabwe's vice-president freed after collapse of attempted murder case
items.description: Marry Mubaiwa had been held on remand for seven years after being charged in 2019 for her then husband's attempted murder.

items.title: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
items.description: Polls have closed in the Israeli election, but there is no clear winner.

items.title: What we know about Ukraine-Russia truce in Oleshky, brokered by Melania Trump
items.description: The Russian-occupied city of Oleshky has had no electricity, gas or water for three years, as residents reported having to eat weeds to survive.
